Spatial domain from an ICCAT-like GeoPackage

Source: R/domain.R
om_domain_from_gpkg.Rd

Reads a grid layer and a stock-area layer, keeps the grid cells that belong to the stock area, repairs invalid geometries, computes the geodesic area of each cell on the WGS84 ellipsoid with lwgeom (geodesic_area_km2()), derives the integer lattice indices used by the random fields and classifies cells into latitudinal regions. This is the function used to build the domain of Experimento 02 from ICCAT_gis.gpkg (the file is never written): with the defaults it returns exactly the cells, lattice and polygons of that domain.

Usage

om_domain_from_gpkg(
  path,
  layer_grid = "grids_01x01",
  layer_stock = "bigeye_tuna_stock_areas",
  stock_code = "BET-A",
  id_field = "CODE",
  lon_field = "CENTER_LON",
  lat_field = "CENTER_LAT",
  region_breaks = c(-20, 20),
  region_labels = c("R01", "R02", "R03"),
  selection = c("intersects", "point_on_surface"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Path to the GeoPackage.

layer_grid, layer_stock

Layer names of the 1x1 grid and of the stock areas.

stock_code

Value of the CODE field that identifies the stock.

id_field, lon_field, lat_field

Fields of the grid layer with the permanent cell identifier and its representative point.

region_breaks, region_labels

Latitudinal regions (see classify_regions()).

selection

Rule that assigns cells to the stock area: "intersects" (any contact; rule of Experimento 02, adequate when the stock area is the whole Convention area, as BET-A) or "point_on_surface" (a point on the cell surface lies inside the stock polygon; avoids the cells that only touch the boundary of a smaller stock area, and gives the same cells as om_domain_iccat()).

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

An object of class om_domain (with geometry and stock polygon).
